name: smart-clearance-demo
made_with: Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image, Vertex AI) for the cast sheets and keyframes, with the label maker's MF-2409-117 and MF-2410-118 label photos and pack-chips.webp as references (keyframes4.sh, keyframes5.sh, keyframes7.sh)
Veo 3.1 (veo-3.1-generate-001, Vertex AI, 1080p, no audio) for 12 clips, image to video (clips.sh), each reviewed by Gemini (eyes.py) and cut to its clean seconds, slowed with motion interpolation
LTX 2.5 Fast on this Mac (gen-ltx.py, 720p) for the Tally desk and the closing lane once the Vertex cap was reached; the food bank's van and the landfill are their keyframes on the cut's slow push
three clips reused from SC-154's landing-page film (r1, r2, r4), cut to their clean seconds
the workspace and console apps on the live stack, recorded with a gliding pointer (tour.mjs, tour.json; director.py --until for the walk); the slow week on the stub
Cloud Text-to-Speech, Gemini-TTS Kore at 1.08, for the voice-over (vo.py), every take transcribed back and checked
Lyria 2 (lyria-002, Vertex AI) for the music bed, looped with the lift at the ledger (bed.py)
ffmpeg for the cut (film2.py, overlays.mjs, assemble.py)
postprocess: libx264 crf 18 master (local, src/build/); the tracked copy crf 24, aac 192k, loudnorm I=-14 TP=-1.5; the 720p copy crf 25, aac 128k
cost_usd_clips: counted in the clips' own sidecars (see storyboard.md, The spend)
fictional: every person, company, signature and figure is fictional; no client is named in the narration
